_doc: D5 'Inked Grime' parameter proposal for the visual-engine lane (d5-close, 2026-11-02). world = look_d5.gdshader uniforms (a layer over the look_d4 world print, under the actors; set world_px like look_d4). zoom_amount = [zoom, amount] stops (zoom 1.0 = 32 px/m), linear between stops, clamped: drive the layer's `amount` from the camera zoom. shadow = look_d5_shadow.gdshader uniforms + the cast offset in metres (down-right). part = look_d5_part.gdshader defaults (the D5 character tier, RigDetail: on at tier_on_zoom, full at tier_full_zoom, off below tier_off_zoom). Iteration 7, default-off PROPOSALS (evidence/item35, item36): print = look_d5_print.gdshader uniforms (the world print instead of look_d4: edge ink on the dark side only + world-locked grain); halo = look_d5_halo.gdshader uniforms (a ring sprite under every rig halo: the ink line outside the sticker rim + a soft drop shadow; shadow_m = the shadow offset in metres, down-right, scaled by the caller to screen px; shadow_blur = 0.4 x that offset, min 1 px). Adopt together with world.age_floor 1.0 and world.grain_floor 1.0 (and the D5 roof plates rebuilt as package v9: line gamma 0.6 + the membrane tone, evidence/README.md gap list 9.1). Iteration 9: print.paper_hi 1.0 = sources lighter than cream (lit tops, caps, signs) print a lighter paper, L 0.90+ (evidence/item49); the shader default is 0. Iteration 8 OPTION (owner A/B, evidence/item43): part.fringe_k 1.0 = the concept's off-register vermilion along each part's down-right edge, dried 0.2 toward ink, fading in from 64 to 96 px/m (fringe_fade is in px_scale); 0 = off (default). part.dots_k 1.0 (owner A/B, evidence/item47) = the concept's halftone dot screen in the shaded steel mid-tones, same fade as the fringe; 0 = off (default). Iteration 10 PROPOSAL for the HUD lane (evidence/item50): ui = look_d5_ui.gdshader uniforms on the mipmapped D5 portraits and the phone frame (TextureRect, LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS): error vs a Lanczos reference 4.82 -> 2.53 at a 200 px panel; not for the non-mipmapped full-screen cards (item50b). n5-look 2026-11-04 (targets r2_a5 'middle ground'): world_riso = world plus the riso layer of look_d5.gdshader: riso (the middle-ground dial, 0 = today's print bit-identical, 1 = the lane's middle ground), dot_k/dot_period (a world-locked 45-degree halftone in the mid-tone fills, mean tone kept), plate_k/plate_mis (the colour plate off register: a ghost on the neutral print + a paper sliver), fibre_k/fibre_scale (paper fibre strands), dot_patchy (iteration 9: the halftone contrast dips in soft world-locked patches, uneven riso inking; 0 = even), speck_k/speck_density (iteration 9: sparse world-locked 1 px toner specks on the paper and light fills, r2_a5 grain toned down; 0 = off), and grain 0.5 -> 0.3 (the owner: tone the grain down, do not remove it). look_profiles.json overlay d5_riso reads it for --look=auto and d5; --look=today and d5_today keep the old world key. Iteration 2 (n5-look): world_riso.tan_k (the light neutral ground toned toward the target's tan sheet by TAN, under the actors so the cream bodies pop more; 0 = off) and stain_k/stain_scale (neutral grey-brown blotches with a tide line on the paper and light fills, never red; 0 = off). world_riso.age_floor stays 0: the page is already aged 0.5 at 32 px/m by the zoom ramp, so a floor of 0.5 changed nothing. n5-look iteration 5: fx = look_d5_fx.gdshader uniforms (WeaponFxColour, Rivet's weapon FX cells in the round 2 colour sheet: the cell keeps its colour under a world-locked halftone dot_k/dot_period and the paper tooth grain; ink_snap/paper_snap = how close to ink / cream a pixel prints the page ink / paper; sat = saturation). Used only while weapon_art.json fx_colour_dir is set.
